Body.Content: Leverage the load balancing capabilities of Azure Traffic Manager to create highly responsive and highly available production grade applications. Traffic Manager carries a service level agreement of 99.99%, and is supported through your existing Windows Azure support plan. We are also announcing new pricing for Traffic Manager. Free promotional pricing will remain in effect until December 31, 2013. To learn more, check out Scott Guthrie's blog and the Traffic Manager page.
Body.Markdown:
Leverage the load balancing capabilities of Azure Traffic Manager to create highly responsive and highly available production grade applications.

Traffic Manager carries a service level agreement of 99.99%, and is supported through your existing Windows Azure support plan. We are also announcing new pricing for Traffic Manager. Free promotional pricing will remain in effect until December 31, 2013.

To learn more, check out Scott Guthrie's blog and the Traffic Manager page.
